newsitem.title: USA: U.S. Midcontinent gasoline, diesel prices ease.
newsitem.headline: U.S. Midcontinent gasoline, diesel prices ease.

text.p: U.S. Midcontinent spot unleaded gasoline and diesel prices eased on Friday, tracking a steep drop in underlying NYMEX futures prices in trade on the day.
Refined product differentials in the Group Three and Chicago markets were steady late Friday after firming across the board earlier on perceptions of tightening in regional inventories, traders said.
But the firming differentials could not offset the more the steep drops in June NYMEX heating oil and gasoline prices underlying spot Midwest refined products prices.
Group Three unleaded was bid 1.75 cents a gallon over June NYMEX unleaded for prompt May deliveries and 0.50 cent over the print for later deliveries, traders said.
Chicago unleaded was bid 0.25 cent a gallon over the print for prompt deliveries and remained even with the print for later deliveries.
Group Three low sulphur diesel for May deliveries was talked 6.50/6.75 cents a gallon over June NYMEX heating oil, with Chicago high sulphur bid 2.75/3.0 cents over the print.
